CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_verified_tenant()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT m.tenant_id
    FROM public.tenant_memberships m
   WHERE m.user_id   = auth.uid()
     AND m.tenant_id = public.current_user_active_tenant();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT m.role FROM public.tenant_memberships m
 WHERE m.user_id=auth.uid() AND m.tenant_id=public.current_user_verified_tenant()
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_platform_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT coalesce(
    (SELECT p.is_platform_admin FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = auth.uid()),
    false
  );
$function$
